relationships.subject: BQ123
relationships.evidence_quote: two peptide antagonists of endothelin-1 (ETA) and bradykinin (BKB1), namely BQ123 and R954

relationships.subject: peptide-grafted nanogels
relationships.evidence_quote: attributed to the slow peptide release reducing nitric oxide (NO) and Cyclooxygenase-2 expression

key_findings: Nanogels delivering BQ123 and R954 gave sustained release in synovial fluid up to three months and were biocompatible with human chondrocytes.
Treatment reduced NO and COX-2 expression in vitro after seven days.
